items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free cleanser that won't strip skin that already looks dry.
A gentle 10% azelaic cream to help even the look of dark patches without the irritation of a strong peel.
A ceramide moisturizer to add comfort and support the skin barrier.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides to help keep the look of dark patches from deepening in sun and visible light.

response.routine_note: We left out the 30% peel and the strongest retinol because strong actives can cause irritation that leaves deeper skin tones looking more uneven, so start gently: cleanse, apply azelaic cream, moisturize, and use tinted SPF every morning. Dark patches on the cheeks are best assessed in person, so please see a dermatologist before adding anything stronger.
